title: Content Ops Assistant
one_liner: One campaign brief and four brand sliders become an email, a LinkedIn post and three ad variants, with the system prompt the sliders produce shown on the page.

steps.text: Content ops: use the sample brief, the Ledger Sync launch
Generate: email, LinkedIn and ad copy from one brief
The system prompt the sliders produce
Move the tone slider to Friendly: the prompt changes with it
Formality up three notches: a formal register rule appears
Generate again with the new voice
